headline: Dangote Petroleum Refinery Concludes IPO With Broad Global Participation
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals has closed its landmark initial public offering. The sale attracted investors from 120 countries, including all 54 African nations, establishing a new capital markets milestone.
why: The Dangote refinery in Nigeria is Africa's largest oil processing facility, playing a central role in West African fuel supply and industrial finance.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Global investor participation broadens capital inflow and strengthens domestic industrial balance sheets.
